verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents a test mode that uses testnet blockchains and simulated payments with no real assets moved, plus a widget sandbox that a test API key switches on automatically. That clearly covers rehearsing on-ramp payments without real funds. However, nothing in the evidence shows the sandbox covering off-ramp payouts or swaps/conversions, or providing deterministic test values. Missing for 10: documented sandbox coverage of payouts (off-ramp) and conversions/swaps, deterministic test values (e.g., test cards or magic amounts with fixed outcomes), and independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox behavior.
